title: VTC Admin Events — Subscribe — payload
description: Open an administrator console's live channel of hint-only events. The success response is the first document on a stream that then carries vtc/admin/events/event/0.1 documents; over HTTPS that stream is the streamed response of bindings/https/0.3 §2.1. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

topics.description: The topics the console renders. The community narrows this to the topics the caller may read and reports the result as the response's `topics`.

since.description: The last `resumeToken` the console received on an earlier stream, to resume from. A token the community does not recognise, has expired, or minted for another caller is not an error: the stream starts fresh and the response says `resumed: false`.

Response.title: VTC Admin Events — Subscribe — response payload
Response.description: The subscription as granted, sent as the first document on the stream. Failures use trust-task-error and open no stream.

topics.description: The effective topics: those requested that the caller may read. The community sends events for these and no others. A requested topic missing here is one the caller may not read, and the console MUST NOT present it as live.

heartbeatSeconds.description: The longest the community lets the stream go without sending anything. Over HTTPS the heartbeat is an SSE comment. A console that receives nothing for twice this interval MUST treat the stream as dead.

resumed.description: `true` when the community recognised `since` and will send a hint for every effective topic that changed after it. `false` when no `since` was given or it could not be honoured; the console MUST then re-fetch every effective topic, because it may have missed changes.

resumeToken.description: The stream position as of this response, so that a console that disconnects before its first event still has a token to resume from.
